description: Returns one published federal system of records by exact Federal Files Register ID, with the agency's record description, routine-use text, exemption claim, source record and linked Federal Register notices. Standard agency boilerplate routine uses are omitted unless include_standard is true. A routine use is the agency statement that it MAY disclose; it is not evidence a disclosure occurred. A later notice may change a system without reprinting its full text, so check linked notices and effective dates. Recipient tags and record flags are text matches counted as at least; DHS does not imply ICE. Exemption claims may limit access or correction but do not decide an individual request. A missing ID does not establish that no records are kept.

id.description: Published system id, e.g. DHS:/ICE-009. A missing id does not prove the agency keeps no records.

include_standard.description: Include routine uses marked standard; default false. A routine use says MAY disclose, not that disclosure occurred.

name: federal_file_system
title: Get Federal File System
